sections.title: The letter e
paragraphs: The letter name is (e) /ɛ/. This letter makes a vowel sound, as in (este) /ˈɛʃtɛ/, which means evening. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter has one sound.

sections.title: How to say e
paragraphs: Drop your jaw quite low. Spread your lips slightly. Keep your tongue flat and push it slightly forward. Turn your voice on and let air flow freely. Put your fingers on your throat to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: Spelling of e
paragraphs: This letter always keeps the same short sound in all positions. You hear it at the start and end of (este) /ˈɛʃtɛ/. You also hear it twice in the word (ember) /ˈɛmbɛr/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not make this sound too close, like the vowel in bed. Open your mouth wider than you do for bed. Do not add a glide at the end like the vowel sound in bay.
